narrative.overview:
Every page is an issue of a print travel quarterly about Kerala. The homepage is this season's issue: a cover you book from, a contents page you browse by, and features set as spreads. The system is printed, not rendered: forest-green spot ink laid down as whole spreads, uncoated ivory stock for the reading spreads, and a muted gold foil kept for a handful of marks. Hierarchy comes from scale and face, not from weight, colour badges, or containers.

Density is low and the pace is a magazine's. Sections are full-width grounds with generous vertical padding, content sits on a 12-column grid inside a 1440px measure, and photographs are framed square, captioned, and credited like plates. Motion is settled: content reveals once as it arrives and then stays at rest.

The user pinned the palette (forest greens, warm ivory, earthy neutrals, muted gold) and the pairing of serif headings with sans body. The world refuses the full-bleed photo with a floating white search pill and rows of rounded cards.
keyCharacteristics: Whole-section grounds alternate between green spreads and ivory reading spreads.
Gold is foil: four roles only.
Brygada 1918 at regular weight carries every heading; Anek Latin carries reading and interface text, with a narrow Anek for captions.
Square corners everywhere; depth from grounds and hairline rules, not shadows.
Every photograph has a caption and credit; every sample has a visible "Placeholder" tag; every price has a breakdown.
English and Malayalam are first-class; Malayalam gets its own line-heights and sizes.

rules.name: The Four Foils Rule
rules.body: Gold appears in four roles only: the masthead (on the cover and in its condensed top-bar, menu, and colophon forms); folio and section numerals, including package nights and host step numbers; the field underlines of the search phrases plus the Sea to the Ghats profile line and markers; and the primary button. Labels and links use ivory or earth.

rules.name: The Whole Spread Rule
rules.body: A section takes one ground edge to edge: canopy or forest on green spreads, ivory on reading spreads. Content never sits in a card of one ground floating on another; dividers are hairline rules in the text colour at 10–25% opacity.

rules.name: The Focus Follows Ground Rule
rules.body: Every element sets its outline colour from `--focus` (pale gold by default), so colour transitions never start from currentColor. Ivory grounds switch `--focus` to canopy. The visible ring is a 2px solid outline offset 3px.

rules.name: The Scale-Only Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from size and face, never weight: every heading is Brygada at 400 with -0.01em tracking (the masthead -0.03em). The one heavier weight is the semibold total row of a price breakdown. No uppercase and no positive letter-spacing.

rules.name: The Malayalam Room Rule
rules.body: Under `lang="ml"`, every Brygada line opens to a line-height of 1.3, the masthead and cover line included, tracking returns to 0, and the masthead and cover line step down to `display-ml` and `cover-line-ml`. In headings, paragraphs, and list items a long Malayalam word may break inside itself when nothing else fits a 320px column (`overflow-wrap: anywhere`); buttons and links keep their words whole. Malayalam text falls back to Noto Serif Malayalam and Anek Malayalam inside the same stacks; neither face is preloaded.

rules.name: The One Grid Break Rule
rules.body: Sea to the Ghats is the only element that leaves the 12-column grid: its cross-section bleeds to both viewport edges. Nothing else bleeds, apart from the cover photograph that fills the first viewport.

rules.name: The Ink-and-Stock Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are printed, not lifted: no shadows on cards, photographs, buttons, or sections. A panel that floats over a photograph is the one exception.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: No radius anywhere, including third-party widgets; the calendar's day buttons are overridden to 0.

rules.name: The Credited Photograph Rule
rules.body: A photograph is never shown without a caption and credit beneath it, in label type (earth on ivory, ivory at 70–75% on green): what it shows, a placeholder note while stock is used, and the photographer.

rules.name: The Visible Placeholder Rule
rules.body: Every sample stay, package, letter, field note, and amount carries an inline "Placeholder" tag: label type at 13px, a 1px current-colour border at 45% opacity, 1px by 6px padding. Styling never hides it.

rules.name: The Full Price Rule
rules.body: Every price shows "from ₹ — per night" (Brygada for the amount, tabular figures) with a "Price details" disclosure listing base rate, GST, service fee, and a semibold total, ruled with hairlines. The note follows the dates in the search; packages compute for their own night count and take only a start date from the search. Without dates it asks for them.

dos: **Do** give each section one whole ground: canopy or forest for green spreads, ivory for reading spreads.
**Do** keep gold to its four roles: masthead, numerals, search and profile lines, and the primary button.
**Do** set every heading in Brygada 1918 at 400 and build hierarchy from size alone.
**Do** keep every corner square (0px), including calendars and inputs.
**Do** put a caption and credit under every photograph and a visible Placeholder tag on every sample.
**Do** show a full price breakdown (base, GST, service fee, total) with every price.
**Do** set `--focus` to canopy on any new ivory ground, using the existing on-ivory treatment.
**Do** recompose phone layouts rather than shrinking desktop ones, with 44px minimum targets.
donts: **Don't** use gold for labels, links, tabs, or active states; use ivory or earth.
**Don't** put content in rounded cards, floating white pills, or shadowed tiles.
**Don't** add shadows beyond the picker panel that floats over the cover photograph.
**Don't** use uppercase, tracked caps, or bold headings.
**Don't** break the 12-column grid anywhere except Sea to the Ghats.
**Don't** use laterite decoratively; it marks today's date and validation only.
**Don't** show a fee or tax for the first time at checkout, or a star rating or verified badge anywhere.
